mapper.insert: INSERT INTO allocation_tc_binding(enterprise_id,attempt_id,xid,launch_epoch,cluster_id,application_id,transaction_group,created_at) VALUES(#{enterpriseId},#{attemptId},#{xid},#{epoch},#{scope.clusterId},#{scope.applicationId},#{scope.transactionGroup},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_id=attempt_id
mapper.select: SELECT enterprise_id,attempt_id,xid,launch_epoch,cluster_id,application_id,transaction_group FROM allocation_tc_binding WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND attempt_id=#{attemptId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO allocation_recovery_cursor(enterprise_id,last_attempt_id,version,updated_at) VALUES(#{enterpriseId},NULL,0,#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enterprise_id=enterprise_id
mapper.select: SELECT last_attempt_id,version FROM allocation_recovery_cursor WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId}

SELECT a.id,a.xid,a.launch_epoch,a.participant_set_hash,a.state FROM allocation_attempt a WHERE a.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND a.xid IS NOT NULL AND a.id > #{afterId} AND (a.state IN ('TCC_TRYING','TCC_COMPLETING') OR (a.state='ALLOCATED' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillment_outbox o WHERE o.enterprise_id=a.enterprise_id AND o.attempt_id=a.id) < 1+2*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allocation_participant p WHERE p.enterprise_id=a.enterprise_id AND p.attempt_id=a.id))) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE allocation_recovery_cursor SET last_attempt_id=#{afterId},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND version=#{version}
